title: Filter
text: Filter RF complex baseband signals in Simulink, 1 input, 1 output, {First plot type} sets Plot type; {Design method} sets the filter design method, {Filter type} sets the filter response type, {Implement using filter order}, {Filter order}, {Passband frequency (Hz)} sets the passband frequency 1e9, {Passband attenuation (dB)} sets the passband attenuation 10*log10, {Stopband frequencies (Hz)} sets the stopband frequencies for bandstop filters, {Stopband attenuation (dB)}, {RF frequency (Hz)} sets the center of signal bandwidth, {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted, {Modeling domain}, {Solver} sets the time-domain solvers, {FIR filter length} sets the filter length of 1-D digital filter, {Impulse response arguments} sets the input arguments to plot impulse response, {Step response arguments} sets the input arguments to plot step response, {First plot y-axis units} sets the y-axis units of first plot Magnitude, {Second Plot type} plots type of second plot, {Second plot y-axis units} sets the y-axis units of second plot Magnitude, {X-axis frequency points (Hz)} sets the frequency points to plot S-parameter data, {X-axis scale}, {Y-axis scale} and {Plot Sparameter characteristics} plots S-parameters data. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Time-dependent input signal real scalar | real column | complex scalar | complex column

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Time-dependent output signal complex scalar | complex column

params.name: Design method

params.values: Filter response type Lowpass (default) | Highpass | Bandpass | Bandstop

params.values: Implement using filter order off (default) | on

params.values: Filter order 3 (default) | integer greater than 2

params.name: RF frequency (Hz)
params.values: Center of signal bandwidth 1000000000 (default) | positive real scalar

params.values: Time-domain solvers NDF2 (default) | Trapezoidal | Backward Euler | ode15s | ode23s | ode23t (trap) | ode23tb (trap+BE)
